## Contract / supersession preflight

- [ ] Checked live `main`, overlapping PRs/issues and latest accepted design decisions.
- [ ] Reviewed [supersession register](../docs/SUPERSESSION_REGISTER.md) (especially historic proof vs current product behavior).
- [ ] **Reuse:** [existing code/data/tests worth keeping; or N/A]
- [ ] **Replace:** [superseded behavior and tests intentionally replaced; or N/A]
- [ ] **Retire:** [historical-only assumptions/artifacts not to extend; or N/A]
- [ ] Pending design choices are **not** silently treated as approved.
- [ ] New acceptance matches the latest approved contract; old green tests are not used to block an explicitly superseding design.

## Playable validation (or docs-only note)

- Deterministic/Save/Load: 
- Godot native + exported Web: 
- Windows export/runtime & human UX: 
- Explicitly out of scope:
